call.x: Apply for funding to pursue a flagship applied research and innovation programme aimed at harnessing engineering biology to address major industrial and societal challenges through a mission focus. You must be based at an organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
n: Run by UK Research and Innovation. The organiser sets the rules; Eligible Calls reads this call from UKRI Funding Finder (ukri.org).

UKRI-engineering-biology-programme-missi.heading: How we will assess your application

blocks.text: We expect to use Distributed Peer Review (DPR) as part of the assessment of applications to this funding opportunity. DPR is a mechanism whereby applicants to a funding opportunity also act as reviewers. We will expect each applicant team to nominate team members who are equipped to act as reviewers, meaning individuals with the capacity, knowledge and confidence to provide comprehensive, quality reviews. Further information on DPR will follow.

HE-GA-B.title: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026-2027, General Annexes, B - Eligibility

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
